connector.none: a page fetch with response headers; the Claude side serves the same response through its HTTP mock

reads.note: HTTP Request v4.2: GET of the URL the person typed, redirects followed (max 5), Full Response with Response Format text, so n8n emits {body, headers, statusCode, statusMessage}; Extract Headers for Debug and the configuration audit read the headers, the content audit reads the body. The site is invented; its headers and HTML are what a small shop on an old stack might serve. Listed for a side that adds a scheme itself; n8n 2.47.7's HTTP Request v4.2 throws 'Invalid URL: … URL must start with "http" or "https"' and sends nothing

branches: Scrape Website fails on the scheme-less URL; no audit runs and no email is sent
expect.offline: Both audits are model-driven (n8n's replies are recorded). The page is fetched once; the form trigger answers on receipt (no Form page follows), so nothing waits
